---
name: Work item
about: Something to build or change, written so it can be picked up without the conversation behind it
labels: needs-triage
---

**Outcome.** What is true when this is done.

**Context.** Pointers: PRD section, ADRs, glossary terms, related issues.

**Guardrails.** What must not change. What's out of scope. What must not exist yet.

**Acceptance.** Commands that must pass, invariants that must hold.

**Human verification.** How someone who didn't build it confirms it.
